paras: Philothamnus bequaerti, commonly known as Bequaert's green snake, is a species of snake in the subfamily Colubrinae of the family Colubridae. The species is native to central Africa.
P. bequaerti is found in Cameroon, Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Sudan, and Uganda.
